sections.content:
Mastering clitics in Spanish requires three rules:
1. Form: Direct (me, te, lo/la, nos, los/las) vs. Indirect (me, te, le, nos, les).
2. Order: Indirect always before Direct (me lo, te la, nos los).
3. Transformation: le/les + lo/la/los/las → se lo, se la, se los, se las.

sections.title: Pronoun System at a Glance
rows: me lo, te la, nos los, nos las
se lo, se la, se los, se las (never le lo)
Before the verb: 'Se lo dije ayer.'
Before or attached: 'Se lo voy a dar' / 'Voy a dárselo'
